scenarios.scenario: A catalyst publication reports ethylene FE but omits key operating conditions.
expected_behavior: Do not predict performance for a new catalyst

scenarios.scenario: Clean-slab DFT favors separated Ag atoms over adjacent Ag atoms in Ag2Cu34/Cu(100).
expected_behavior: Distinguish energy ordering from catalytic activity
Do not infer ethylene FE or CO transfer

scenarios.scenario: Two measurements report different ethylene responses under incompletely specified conditions.
An experimental gate references a source file whose SHA-256 differs from the registry.
Matched-pattern electrolysis is marked qualified while fabrication qualification remains pending.
expected_behavior: Prevent progression based on the invalid qualification

scenarios.scenario: Ag-patterned Cu produces more ethylene, but surface area, transport and local CO exposure are not independently characterized.
expected_behavior: Avoid attributing the improvement uniquely to CO transfer

limitations: Scenarios are synthetic scientific challenges, not experimental results.
Expected behaviors require expert review before formal benchmarking.
No model accuracy or scientific reliability score has been established.
